text:
Residents:
Yuki (early 50s) works from home. Weekdays: at desk in bedroom_1 from 9:00 to ~17:30. May leave for lunch. Weekends: sleeps in, errands midday, home otherwise. Hobbies: friends, gym, running.
Nora (40s) works in town. Weekdays: out 8:00–17:30. Weekends: sleeps in, errands midday, home otherwise. Hobbies: napping, reading, sketching. Cares for the dog.

Object Locations & Movement:
- laptop_yuki, charger_yuki, pen_yuki: Usually on desk_b1 during work hours (9:00–17:30 weekdays). Charger moves to nightstand_b1 in the evening. May move to couch_l1 or armchair_l1 in evenings.
- tablet_yuki, book_yuki: On nightstand_b1. Tablet moves to desk_b1 during work hours.
- gym_bag_yuki: In wardrobe_b1. Taken out for gym sessions.
- running_shoes_yuki: On shoe_rack_e1. Taken out for running.
- jacket_yuki, hat_yuki, scarf_yuki, umbrella_yuki: On entry_hook_e1. Taken out when Yuki leaves the house.
- keys_yuki, wallet_yuki, shoes_yuki: On entry_table_e1/shoe_rack_e1. Taken out when Yuki leaves.
- sketchbook_nora, pencil_case_nora: On desk_b2. Used for sketching at home.
- book_nora: On nightstand_b2. May move to bed_b2 for reading.
- skincare_nora, toiletry_bag_nora, razor_nora, towel_nora: In bathroom. Used daily.
- dog_leash_shared, dog_bowl_shared, dog_food_bag_shared, dog_toy_shared: Dog items. Leash taken out for walks.
- vacuum_cleaner_shared: On entry_floor_e1. Used for cleaning.
- shopping_bag_shared: In pantry_shelf_k1. Likely contains groceries.
- snack_bowl_shared, fruit_bowl_shared: On kitchen_table_k1. Consumed and refilled.
- blanket_shared, cushions: On couch_l1. Used for comfort.
- remote_shared: On tv_stand_l1. Used for TV.
- board_game_shared: On bookshelf_l1.

Nora’s Work Items (Out 8:00–17:30 weekdays):
- backpack_nora, laptop_nora, lunchbox_nora, notebook_nora, pen_nora, phone_nora, water_bottle_nora: Taken out in the morning. Returned in the evening.
- jacket_nora, scarf_nora, shoes_nora, sunglasses_nora, wallet_nora, keys_nora: Taken out in the morning. Returned in the evening.

Kitchen Items:
- mug_yuki, bowl_yuki, plate_yuki, water_bottle_yuki: Cycle between cupboard_k1, sink_k1, and kitchen_table_k1. Used during meals and cleaning.
- mug_nora, bowl_nora, glass_nora, water_bottle_nora: Cycle between cupboard_k1, sink_k1, and nightstand_b2.
- glass_yuki: Cycles between sink_k1, dish_rack_k1, and pantry_shelf_k1.
- pot_shared, cutting_board_shared: On counter_k1 or cupboard_k1. Moved to sink_k1/kitchen_table_k1 during cooking.
- laundry_basket_shared: In wardrobe_b1.
